title: Search interest rises for CONMEBOL Sudamericana as São Paulo reaches quarterfinals
description: Recent reports indicate São Paulo beat Bolívar to reach the quarterfinals of the Copa Sudamericana, sparking search interest in Brazil.

sections.heading: Match Outcome
paragraphs: According to gol.conmebol.com, São Paulo beat Bolívar with authority to seal their place in the quarterfinals. OneFootball also reported that São Paulo beat Bolívar to reach the last eight.

sections.heading: Tournament Progression
paragraphs: Goal.com noted that the Brazilian side reached the Copa Sudamericana quarter-finals after beating Bolivar. OneFootball added that this victory helped the team end a wait and reach the last eight.
